tests.name: real websocket authenticated and automatic user room
joining another user room disconnects client
quiz publish sends one live notification only to assigned student and admin
repeated publish does not duplicate notifications
class announcement delivered live with recipient isolation
logout disconnects same session but preserves second login
password change disconnects all sessions and accepts only refreshed cookie
packet middleware rejects DB-revoked session version
removed SQLite session rejected during packet revalidation
expired SQLite session rejected during packet revalidation
idle inactive client disconnected by real 30-second session timer

scope: Production setupSocket, auth/quiz/announcement/notification routes and storage; real loopback websocket/polling; real disposable Prisma SQLite and connect-sqlite3 sessions. Express test composition excludes full index middleware (CSRF, rate limiter, proxy/TLS) and browser UX. No SMTP/AI worker or external network.
